messages:
Asha (Design): spitballing a dashboard "pill" that prioritizes p95 but gives a one-line time distribution: p95 big, then a 10-cell micro histogram, tiny sample badge. goal: very dense fleet scan (40+ pills). thoughts?
Marco (PM): sounds useful. ops teams want quick red flags + one-click to traces. keep pill height <= 56px. make the regression state obvious at glance.
Devon (Eng): backend note: we can return 10 pre-bucketed counts per route if we pre-aggregate. exact buckets on-demand is heavy. recommend approx bins + a flag.
Ravi (Data): agreed. API pattern: GET /metrics/latency?routes[]=...&bins=10&approx=true -> {p95, bins:[...], sample_rate:0.1, conf: 15}. UI should surface sample_rate and a confidence value for p95.
Nia (A11y): a11y checklist: color-only reg flags fail for low-vision. add an icon (arrow) and textual delta e.g., "+120ms". micro hist must be keyboard-focusable and expose textual summary like "Most requests 10-50ms; tail to 700ms".
Asha (Design): microcopy idea: primary: "p95 230ms"; secondary tiny: "~10% sampled" when applicable. ~ badge with aria-label "Approximate values: sampling enabled".
Marco (PM): sampling toggle copy: "Approximate values from 10% sampling. Run exact query to compute precise metrics (may take 1010s and increase cost)." Button: "Run exact query"
Devon (Eng): implement exact-run as an async job + progress UI. warn users before firing heavy queries. rate-limit per org for exact requests.
Ravi (Data): include confidence as text, not only a visual cue: "p95  230ms (±15ms)" so screen readers get it.
Nia (A11y): don't use opacity alone for uncertainty. pair with small text "low confidence" when sample_rate < 0.25. ensure focus rings visible at small sizes.
Asha (Design): interaction plan: default pill -> hover/focus expands inline panel with full histogram, percentiles list, and "Open traces" CTA. keyboard: Enter expands; Escape collapses.
Marco (PM): can we add a tiny trend sparkline above the micro hist in the expanded panel colored by bucket intensity? ops teams asked for at-a-glance trend.
Devon (Eng): expanded trend is ok but keep resolution small (e.g., 24x10) to cap payload. we'll return a heatmap matrix only on expanded requests.
Ravi (Data): also cache exact-run results for 5m and mark UI as "cached" when reused.
ci-bot: deployed pill-density-latency-preview to staging: https://staging.redwood/team/dashboards
Asha (Design): I'll drop two Figma variants (minimal pill + expanded inline panel) with a11y annotations and microcopy by EOD. please flag any missing API fields now.
